items.title: How a sextortion victim took power away from his blackmailer
items.description: Authorities received more than 2,200 complaints of sexual extortion in Australia between July and December 2025. Most victims were young men and boys. Two people targeted by scammers share their experience.

items.title: Runaway train with no driver travelled faster than 60km/h
items.description: The fully laden coal train started rolling downhill during a crew change in the NSW Hunter Valley.

items.title: Body found after house fire in NSW coastal town
items.description: A person is dead after a house fire at Kiama on the NSW south coast, which police are not treating as suspicious.

items.title: Albanese evasive over Point Piper dinner attendance
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese attempts to skirt questions about his attendance at a dinner hosted by a billionaire family accused of funnelling money from China, saying he attends "a lot of dinners".

items.title: Sister of missing kayaker 'heartbroken' as search wraps up
items.description: The search for Shane Wilson along the Goulburn River in Victoria has wrapped up without success, despite the family's pleas for it to continue.

items.title: First H5 bird flu case confirmed on SA metro beach
items.description: The CSIRO says two native birds found dead on separate beaches in South Australia have tested positive for the H5 strain of bird flu. It's the first time a case has been confirmed on a SA metropolitan beach.

items.title: 'How do I not have enough money to live?' The nomadic life of a bee drover
items.description: When Sophia Croker was 18, she took out a $40,000 loan to buy 120 beehives. Now she manages nearly 2,000 hives with her father and spends her life travelling around regional Australia in pursuit of honey.

items.title: Tim Tszyu beats Errol Spence Jr by unanimous decision
items.description: Tim Tszyu beats Errol Spence Jr in a blockbuster non-title boxing match in Sydney by unanimous decision.

items.title: Live: Nasiah magic sparks Saints win as 'stupid' act lands Lion in strife
items.description: Nasiah Wanganeen-Milera kicks four goals and picks up 46 disposals in St Kilda's win over North Melbourne as Ty Gallop finds himself in hot water after Brisbane's win. Follow live.

items.title: Live: A perfect 10 for Cronulla in Manly mauling
items.description: Cronulla halfback Nicho Hynes has played the game of his life to lead the Sharks to a thumping victory over Manly. Follow live.

items.title: Quick hits: Photographer watches partner win gold, tiny nation makes history
items.description: The partner of an Australian gold medallist nervously watches his final while working on the pool deck, while a swimmer loses her cap in the middle of a race. Here are the quick hits from day two of the Commonwealth Games.

items.title: Decades-old cold case still haunts family of murdered teenager
items.description: The family of Mandy Lee Yodgee is calling for a $1 million reward to be offered for information that could solve the mystery of the Victorian teenager's death.

items.title: Police accidentally shoot woman while responding to Cairns knife incident
items.description: Police say officers were responding to an "extremely dangerous" incident involving an armed man on a residential Cairns street.

items.title: Inside Prince William's plan to reshape the monarchy
items.description: As heir to the throne, William was born into singular privilege. How he uses it and the work he chooses to pursue present a 'manifesto' for the king he will become.

items.title: Love story: When going on tour becomes a family affair
items.description: When acoustic roots duo Busby Marou were wrapping up their first national tour in Sydney, singer Tom Busby wasn’t expecting to meet the love of his life. Fifteen years later, he and his now-wife Huma are embarking on their own tour of Australia, along with their four children.

items.title: The 10 books our critics couldn't put down in July
items.description: This month's best new books include an erotic novel set in a Tasmanian lighthouse, a 'wonderfully weird debut' about a woman's obsession with a cat and a Harlem heist novel.

items.title: 'Gonna bury him in his van': Ice Cream King marks 40 years
items.description: Alex Deak has been serving frosty treats to the people of Mount Gambier since 1986 and he says he does not intend to give up his crown for a while yet.

items.title: Families fight for airmen killed in Taipan crash to be added to honour roll
items.description: Today, the four men will be immortalised with the erection of a permanent memorial near the place where part of their helicopter was dragged out of the water.

items.title: How starstruck fan's dream unravelled into UK celebrity's rape trial
items.description: The alleged details of a fateful encounter between a UK celebrity and a starstruck fan were replayed in a West Australian court this week. Here's what we have learnt in YouTuber Yung Filly's rape trial so far.

items.title: The generational shift that has seen 'generic' shops pushed to the wall
items.description: It has been a brutal year for Australian retail, with high rents, wage increases and the cost-of-living squeeze forcing big brands to make some hard calls. Here's why some are still surviving.

items.title: Trillion-dollar super war chest waiting to be unleashed on green projects
items.description: Australian super funds manage $4.5 trillion in retirement savings, but directing some of that war chest towards the clean energy transition could be more difficult than it seems.

items.title: More parents refusing lifesaving vitamin K injection for newborns
items.description: Rates of parents consenting to vitamin K injections for newborns are dropping, as misinformation spreads among anti-vax communities on social media.

items.title: In one vital WWI battlefield, Aussie archaeologists are digging again
items.description: On the edge of a tiny village in northern France, a team of archaeologists are digging through ground that was fought for, and won, by the sacrifice of Australian soldiers.

items.title: Father of tourist killed in Laos calls police probe 'incompetent'
items.description: The families of six people, including two Australians, who died from suspected mass methanol poisoning at a Laos hostel have described the outcome of a 20-month police investigation into the incident as "false".

items.title: Police identify suspect after van hits Berlin pride parade crowd
items.description: A Berlin pride parade is called off and a manhunt is underway after a van crashes into a crowd.
